item.title: Fact brief: Does the US Federal Government have nuclear missiles located in South Dakota?
item.description: (South Dakota News Watch) The United States has thousands of nuclear missiles spread out across the country, but there haven’t been any in South Dakota since the early 1990s. There were 15 launch control facilities for 150 Minuteman missile silos in western South Dakota in the region of Ellsworth Air Force Base starting in 1963. item.title: DOC announces inmate serving sentence from charges out of Brown County passes away
item.description: The South Dakota Department of Corrections has announced the passing of an inmate Sunday. 57-year-old Shannon Kilber passed away on March 8th in the medical housing unit at the Jaemson Prison in Sioux Falls. Kilber was serving a 5-year sentence from Brown County on aggravated assault at the time of his death.
